title: 日本ダービーの後に・勝者とは、

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a fierce battle, Winning Ticket comes out on top at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone celebrates the racer for finally fulfilling her dream. It's a dazzling sight for Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she's not one to settle for anything but first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin reaffirms her dedication to keep pushing on, so she can seize victory at the final race of the Triple Crown tour—the Kikuka Sho.
